title: As-Salah: The Pillar of the Deen and the Identity of the Mu'min
summary: At the age of 10-12, the child begins to understand the meaning of taklif (responsibility). Salah is not a routine but a connection with Allah. Parents: be role models, discuss: Why do we pray? And how do we pray with khushu'?
try_this: This week: Create a "Salah diary" for your child in which they record their salah and how they felt afterward. Discuss weekly: What did you feel?
reflection_prompts: Which salah is the most difficult for your child? And why?
How has the Salah diary affected their commitment?
